==Game Information==

Global Assault is a turn-based tactical war game. Players gather [[Units]], [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Credits Credits] (currency), [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Scrap Scrap] (upgrade points) and other resources to build an army, using specialized powerful units to defeat their enemies.
